tests.name: Real settings More flashes only its rectangle and restores before the action
Root popup remains two rows; search is not copied into subpages
Scrollable settings have a 44-unit lane, 12-unit content gap and 16-unit edge inset
Scrollbar arrow and track taps move settings without activating a row
Dragging the settings thumb reaches both bounds and does not jump on initial grab
A content swipe crossing the scrollbar stays a content swipe
Disabled hits do not flash; explicit flash_ui off still executes exactly once
Framebuffer is restored even when feedback rendering fails
Changing route discards old rail and row hits before the next paint
Home remains a fixed viewport; editor list has its own independent rail
Font picker rail is operable and selection rows stay outside its lane
Switching font panel tab drops stale rail and dragging state immediately
Hold-drag events seek the font list and honor the final release position
Long saved-theme grids also reserve the gutter without covering either column
Closed overlay hits cannot flash or invoke their old action
TOC rail has separate spacing and arrow taps do not jump the document
TOC content swipe crossing into its rail does not become a seek
Statistics use the same rail; closing via a flashing button leaves no overlay
